scientific_integrity: The infinite reduction is an elementary symbolic proof from the defining divisibility condition. The finite script only checks explicit witnesses and regression cases; it is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The result treats only positive parameters and gives a one-way reduction: a positive counterexample would imply a new Fermat prime, but a new Fermat prime would not imply a counterexample. Literature non-detection cannot exclude an unindexed prior observation.
title: Positive \(\mu\)-Sondow small-witness conjecture reduces to new Fermat primes
